Plan_of_Care.content: Treat acute headache, considered probable migraine
Trial ibuprofen together with paracetamol for headache management
Provide safety-net advice to seek care if headache worsens or does not settle, if there is any change in headache character, high temperature, rash, or feeling unwell
Plan_of_Care.source_text: – Safety-net: seek care if worsening/not settling, any change in HA character, high temperature, rash, or if unwell
